verdict.rationale: Treasury emits events such as v2.money_management.transaction.created, so a platform can subscribe and trigger its own actions. The docs also say platforms must build and operate their own controls over money movement. That means event-driven automation is possible, but the rule logic must be custom-built rather than defined in a native rules engine. Missing for 10: a native user-definable rules/trigger engine, documented webhook-to-action workflows, and independent or hands-on corroboration of event-driven automation.
